Each chapter covers one class in more detail than the lecture can. Read the
chapter before (or right after) the class. Each one ends with key points and
study questions, and has a printable PDF version under *Other Formats*.

The first six classes build the theory. Classes 1–3 approximate the **wave
function** (basis sets) and come before Experiment 1. Classes 4–6 approximate the
**Hamiltonian** (Hartree–Fock and density functional theory) and come before
Experiment 2. From Class 7 on, each class looks back at the experiment you just
finished and prepares the next one.

::: {.callout-note}
## Debrief sections
From Class 7 on, the first part of each chapter discusses the results of the previous
experiment. Read it **after** you submit that experiment. Your predictions are
more useful if they're your own.
:::
